issue.title: Bug: [Error Log] [counters] Intermittent error logs seen from syncd while running port_rate lua plugin

failure.body:

generic

resolution.title: [syncd] Fix the error log while running lua plugin
resolution.description:
**What I did**

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24342

**Why I did it**

Variable is uninitialized which is causing the error logs mentioned in the issue during startup

**How I verified it**

Don't see the error logs after this fix

**Details if related**
